title: Regulating sodium deposition and interfacial chemistry via sulfur-embedded carbon spheres enables high-power Ah-level <mark>sodium-metal</mark> batteries
abstract: Published online: 15 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-78242-0 Sodium metal batteries offer high <mark>energy density</mark> but suffer from dendritic Na growth and unstable interphases. Here, authors design sulfur-embedded mesoporous carbon spheres that regulate Na deposition and form a robust NaF-rich <mark>interphase</mark>, enabling high power Ah-level sodium metal batteries with long cycle life.

title: Evidence for multi-Li<sup>+</sup> clustering in lithium-ion battery electrolytes
abstract: Published online: 14 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11138-7 Machine-learning-enabled atomistic simulations, spectroscopy, electrochemical data and quantum-chemical calculations reveal previously unstudied multi-lithium-ion complexes without bound anions, improving understanding of lithium-ion-battery functionality at the atomic level.

title: Your battery may not be a battery
abstract: Published online: 15 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41565-026-02296-w The widespread use of the term ‘battery’ has caused misunderstandings about what truly defines a battery. In this Comment, we critically examine the terminology and fundamental concepts of batteries to favour reliable interdisciplinary advancement of energy storage technology and research.
